lead: Diya Kumari is best known as an Indian politician, born on 30 January 1971 in Jaipur.
As of 2026, she is 55 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aquarius sign.
She has held the office of Member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Diya facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Diya Kumari — Career and Professional Work
paras: Diya Kumari works primarily as a politician.
